title: Kwegu or Muguji | Local Tour Ethiopia
text: The Kwegu or Muguji are one of the smallest tribes in Omo Valley, living in small villages along the Mago River. The Kwegu speak the Kwegu language as a mother tongue, which belongs to the Nilo-Saharan language family. Unlike the other tribes, the Kwegu do not have cattle.
